1.explanation: These files define how individual Tab components render their label text (Tab/index.js, Tab/Tab.js, Tab/Tab.scss) and how the Tabs container lays out those Tab components (Tabs/index.js, Tabs/Tabs.js, Tabs/Tabs.scss). Inspecting and adjusting the CSS for text-overflow and padding in these components is required to reproduce and fix the ellipsis/truncation at 16px from the edge.
1.bug_scenario: In the custom “Container tabs” variant (first screenshot), long tab labels are rendered in full and overflow the container edge, whereas in the “Default tabs” (second screenshot) the text is truncated with an ellipsis about 16px from the tab boundary. The bug involves the Tab label container, its CSS for text-overflow, and the Tabs wrapper that positions each Tab. The relevant elements are the Tab label text, the Tab button/container, and the Tabs scrolling/wrapping container.
